szoveg_eredeti:
ElevenLabs is now available as a connected app on LinkedIn , so you can share your expertise directly on your profile.

Add ElevenLabs as a connected app, and a capability statement determined by your usage will automatically appear on your profile. Showcase your abilities - from dubbing and producing voice content in ElevenCreative, to building and deploying voice agents in ElevenAgents, to integrating voice and audio through ElevenAPI.

To add ElevenLabs as a connected app:
1. In LinkedIn, scroll down to the “Connected apps” section on your profile, select “Add connected apps,” and select “Add” next to ElevenLabs. 
2. In ElevenLabs, select “Connect.” 
3. Your capability statement syncs automatically and appears in the Connected apps section of your LinkedIn profile.
